hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qi 'Co-Authored-By: Claude'; then echo '❌ Co-Authored-By Claude forbidden. Use Nika 🦋 only.'; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then LOC=$(wc -l < "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$LOC" -gt 1500 ]; then echo "⚠️ WARNING: $FILE has $LOC lines (>1500 cap)"; fi; fi
echo '🦋 Session ended. Remember: update STATE.md if crate admitted.'

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'cargo test' && ! echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\-\-lib'; then echo '⚠️ WARNING: cargo test without --lib may trigger macOS Keychain popup. Use --lib flag.'; fi
echo '💎 Nika Diamond session. Branch: '$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')'. Read MEMORY.md first.'
